source_arguments.statement:
theorem constitutiveSameDefect_split_nonsplit_carry_holonomy :
    (∃ s : ConstitutiveBit →+ ConstitutiveSplitMiddle,
        constitutiveSplitQuotient.comp s = AddMonoidHom.id ConstitutiveBit) ∧
      (¬ ∃ s : ConstitutiveBit →+ ConstitutiveCarryMiddle,
        constitutiveCarryQuotient.comp s = AddMonoidHom.id ConstitutiveBit) ∧
      (∀ a b : ConstitutiveBit,
        constitutiveSplitSection a + constitutiveSplitSection b -
          constitutiveSplitSection (a + b) = constitutiveSplitInclusion 0) ∧
      (constitutiveCarrySection 1 + constitutiveCarrySection 1 -
        constitutiveCarrySection (1 + 1) = constitutiveCarryInclusion 1) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveBaseHistory (n + 2) = constitutiveBaseHistory n) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveSplitHistory (n + 2) = constitutiveSplitHistory n) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveCarryHistory (n + 2) =
        constitutiveCarryHistory n + constitutiveCarryInclusion 1) ∧
      constitutiveCarryInclusion 1 ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveCarryHistory (n + 4) = constitutiveCarryHistory n)

source_arguments.name: GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.nomogenicPeriodicProducer_phaseQuotient_recurrence_openPrefix
source_arguments.statement:
theorem nomogenicPeriodicProducer_phaseQuotient_recurrence_openPrefix :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      constitutiveCarryQuotient (constitutiveCarryHistory n) = constitutiveBaseHistory n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveBaseHistory (n + 2) = constitutiveBaseHistory n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveCarryHistory (n + 2) =
      constitutiveCarryHistory n + constitutiveCarryInclusion 1) ∧
    constitutiveCarryInclusion 1 ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveCarryHistory (n + 2) ≠ constitutiveCarryHistory n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, constitutiveCarryHistory (n + 4) = constitutiveCarryHistory n) ∧
    (¬ ∃ d : ConstitutiveBit → ConstitutiveCarryMiddle,
      ∀ n : ℕ, d (constitutiveBaseHistory n) = constitutiveCarryHistory n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, (nomogenicSourcePrefix n).length = n) ∧
    (∀ bound : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, bound < (nomogenicSourcePrefix n).length) ∧
    (constitutiveCarrySection 1 + constitutiveCarrySection 1 -
      constitutiveCarrySection (1 + 1) = constitutiveCarryInclusion 1)

    {σ τ : ℂ} (hv : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(1 : ℂ), σ, τ])
    {F P : meroField (Set.univ : Set ℂ)} {a b : ℂ}
    (hFone : addTranslationMeroEquiv 1 F = F) (hPone : addTranslationMeroEquiv 1 P = P)
    (hσ : addTranslationMeroEquiv σ F - F
      = (addTranslationMeroEquiv σ P - P) + algebraMap ℂ (meroField (Set.univ : Set ℂ)) a)
    (hτ : addTranslationMeroEquiv τ F - F
      = (addTranslationMeroEquiv τ P - P) + algebraMap ℂ (meroField (Set.univ : Set ℂ)) b) :
    (∃ c : ℂ, F - P = algebraMap ℂ (meroField (Set.univ : Set ℂ)) c) ∧ a = 0 ∧ b = 0
